name: SOURCE
description: Source of the KPI, such as CLCM, Digital, Wealth, CX or Revenue.

name: MARKET
description: Name of the market. In-scope markets include SGH, UAE, INM, AOC, EXP, MYH, TWN, USA and MEX

name: METRIC
description: The actual metric name used to derive the final KPI.

name: METRIC_TYPE
description: Tier of the metric: L1 headline metrics, L2 core metrics or L3 business metrics.

name: SEGMENT
description: Customer segment, such as Premier or Personal Banking.

name: GROUP_ALL
description: Used for the CX area to identify whether the KPI relates to tNPS, complaints or another group.

name: MEET_TARGET
description: Used for the CX area to identify whether the market has met the target for a specific KPI.

name: CHANNEL
description: Customer onboarding channel, such as Digital, Mobile or CC.

name: UNIT_TYPE
description: Unit of the metric, such as $, # or %.

name: VS_YE_TARGET
description: Comparison value against the year-end target value.

name: SQ_APPETITE
description: Defined risk appetite value, target or limit set for the metric.

name: SQ_TOLERANCE
description: Tolerance threshold around the appetite - the acceptable variance beyond appetite before a breach is formally recorded.

name: SQ_BREACH_CODE
description: Code identifying the breach status or type where the measured value exceeds appetite or tolerance.

name: PRODUCT_TYPE
description: Product type, particularly for Digital Sales metrics such as Wealth or Retail.

name: CORRIDOR
description: Corridor name, specifically for Funds Flow.

name: YEAR
description: Reporting year.

name: REPORTING_MONTH
description: Reporting month.

name: MTD_ACTUAL
description: Monthly actual value for the metric.

name: MTD_PLAN
description: Monthly plan for the metric.

name: YTD_ACTUAL
description: YTD actuals value for the metric.

name: YTD_PLAN
description: YTD plan value for the metric.

name: PY_MTD_ACTUAL
description: Previous year corresponding monthly actuals value for the metric.

name: PY_YTD_ACTUAL
description: Previous year corresponding YTD actuals value for the metric.

name: FY_FORECAST
description: Full year forecast value.

name: FY_PLAN
description: Full year plan value.

name: MOM
description: Month-over-month change value.

name: PM_ACTUAL
description: Previous month actuals value.

name: VS_PLAN
description: Comparison value against the plan.

name: VS_PY
description: Comparison value against the previous year.
